    About

    Description

    Joanne Rowling CH OBE FRSL, known by her pen name J. K. Rowling, is a British author and philanthropist. She wrote Harry Potter, a seven-volume fantasy series published from 1997 to 2007. Wikipedia
    Born: July 31, 1965 (age 59 years), Yate, United Kingdom
    Children: Jessica Isabel Rowling Arantes, Mackenzie Jean Rowling Murray, David Gordon Rowling Murray
    Spouse: Neil Murray (m. 2001), Jorge Arantes (m. 1992–1993)
    Full name: Joanne Kathleen Rowling
    Education: University of Exeter (1983–1986) · See more
